description: Ex Fuerza Aérea del Perú '106' (December 1975), to the FAA June 1982 as C-410, later Mara C-610; fuselage mounted on three pillars in 2019 (inaugurated 1 May 2019) in a Dagger colour scheme with a Dagger nose while keeping its own serial. Photographed 15 January 2023.
